title: SDR-RDMA: Software-Defined Reliability Architecture for Planetary Scale RDMA Communication
problem: RDMA reliability layer design is complicated by millisecond-scale long-haul latencies; Selective Repeat inefficient for some link conditions
motivation: Enable flexible, efficient reliability schemes for inter-datacenter RDMA communication adapted to link characteristics
method: SDR-RDMA software-defined reliability stack with receive buffer bitmap; DPA offload for line-rate performance; extensible reliability schemes
key_novelty: Software-defined RDMA reliability enabling custom schemes beyond Selective Repeat; DPA offload achieving line-rate; preserves zero-copy semantics
contributions: SDR-RDMA architecture with receive buffer bitmap for partial completion
Extensible reliability scheme support (Selective Repeat, Erasure Coding variants)
DPA offload implementation for line-rate performance
limitations: Implementation details limited; evaluation on specific link conditions not detailed; generalization to non-AI workloads unclear
primary_theme: Software-defined RDMA reliability for distributed training
